notes.title: Stealth mechanics update now live!
notes.content:
[b]Patch v1.2 - Stealth mechanics update now live![/b]
To celebrate the stealth update for AKAI NOROI the game is 50% off for two weeks running from June 22th 12:00 pm ( US Pacific time ) to July 6th 12:00 pm!

This update brings new mechanics to AKAI NOROI and implements stealth mechanics in many of the levels, the sleeping quarters, the basement domain of the yurei, AIKO's School & the sewers section.

This will enable the player to hide from enemies in various ways including lockers, crevices and under tables. This is done in order to make the game a bit easier during some sections and give the player a chance to catch their breath and explore the environment more as well as dig into the lore pages hidden within the areas. Thanks to all the players for your feedback.

Patch notes:

[list]
[*] UI Updates in almost the entire game and new red colored theme.
[*] AI tweaks / balancing.
[*] Stealth mechanics in various levels, you can now hide in lockers, crevices and under tables.
[*] Minor fixes + Trigger hints near some puzzles.
[*] Some new scares / audio.
[/list]

Big thanks to all who support me!
My next project is called CATACOMBIA and you can already wish-list the game on Steam if interested!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1469390/CATACOMBIA/

Best regards
Azaxor

notes.title: Save fixed + PS4 Controller support + BIG final patch overhaul v1.1 now LIVE!
notes.content:
Final BIG patch update v1.1 is now LIVE!
Full change log for final patch update v1.1 will be updated shortly here is some of the changes!

*Changes*

[list]
[*] Full controller support and support for PS4 / XBOX Controller through auto detection, connect controller before starting the game, hit the x button in right corner below in main menu.
[*] Auto save's indicated by disc in top right corner and manual saving working properly.
    Should now also save saveables such as pickups and doors plus journals.
[*] Full body awareness (you can see your body in game now)
[*] A new and updated game UI that's more intuitive and polished.
[*] Brand new main menu.
[*] Complete game overhaul, updated engine version and system.
[*] New in game ambiance by composer SINIUS
[*] Enemy balancing / enemy
encounters / spawn / enemy damage output reduced + tweaking.
Fixed a bug where some of the enemies could not detect you when prone / crouched.
[*] Candles burn extremely slow now.
Also fixed a bug with candles not reducing in size and with array being too small causing them to disappear when combined sometimes.
The lighter now has unlimited uses and there are more candles in the sleeping quarters.
Combine 1 candle with the lighter to turn it on, wait till it burns out before turning on a new one, or it gets put back in your inventory accessible by pressing tab.
[*] Additional 3D HUD navigational helpers various places
[*] New enemy in depths of the yurei sewer domain
[*] New in game events in multiple levels + environmental updates in multiple levels
[*] Complete game overhaul in terms of level load structure and updated graphics
[*] Now support inverted mouse look as requested by a player, available in Options section.
[*] And much much more!
[/list]

Hope you enjoy!

notes.title: Launch bug fix patch v1.0 day 2 for AKAI NOROI NOW LIVE
notes.content:
UPDATE 7/25 - Still investigating save issue which will be fixed / replaced in 1-2 weeks or less in a new patch, all other bugs have been fixed. Thanks!
UPDATE 7/26 - New updates live and changelog updated. Atm saving is only working in AKIOs apartment, Hallway01 and AKIO_Revelation.
UPDATE 7/29 I have decided to upgrade the system in order to fix saving, also i will add PS4/XBOX controller support!
Update coming soon as possible.


I apologize for any inconvenience or bugs you have encountered.
The Launch bug fix patch v1.0 is now live!
Below is the updated changelog for the patch.
Hope you enjoy!

1. 3D HUD navigation helpers added in almost all levels to help guide the player.
2. AKIO's room puzzle has had a number added next to the lines to make the puzzle easier to decypher.
3. Reduced agressiveness and damage of first encounter of the red lady and changed how / when she spawns
Additionally a 3D HUD spawns helping the player to progress to the next area.
4. You can now perform a little jump in all levels to avoid being stuck on collisions, even if this is rare.
5. The key in the laundry room hidden in the basket is now near a Japanese doll instead since it was a little too hard to spot.
6. 3D HUD helper added for key on hanging body in sleeping quarters.
7. New principal suicide event in principal office in AIKO's school.
8. Interior updates in sewer domain.
9. English subtitles added for AIKO's voice in the sleeping quarters.

Best regards.
Azaxor
Aza Game Studio
